visual.trigger: Mirrored, rotated, clipped or blurred text during transitions or photo entry
visual.action: Count each visible occurrence, including upside-down copies, in inventory; inspect encoded frames around the full transition. Reuse the procedure, not this source geometry.
visual.observed: Actual frame 90 has both upright and upside-down Spanish title; dense contact sheet shows subsequent transition and independent upload UI. Original review records a second mirrored occurrence at frame 437.
visual.boundary: Selected final frames were inspected in maintenance. No new exhaustive frame review or universal inpainting quality claim.

audio.trigger: An original-language word remains just after the planned speech window
audio.action: Separate source-erasure end from target voice placement. Locate the actual acoustic tail, extend only its removal window, preserve the already checked target take, then inspect the final mux and neighboring music.
audio.observed: Prior external report rejected R1 for English away. Revision changed second erasure end from 7.8 to 8.08 seconds. Recorded final tail interval 7.78-8.04 seconds is -70.286 dBFS versus -17.487 previously. These are source-specific measurements, not universal thresholds.
audio.boundary: Final local ASR/correlation supports continuity and tail attenuation, not independent listening, word-caption timing or lossless separation. No verbatim speech captions existed.

review_reuse.action: Bind historical review to its original video. Reuse only findings about verified corresponding intervals; changed intervals need fresh evidence. Keep rejected findings unchanged.
review_reuse.caution: High correlation is not byte identity or semantic proof. These recorded correlations lack the previous full WAV in this small supplement; do not claim the comparison can be recomputed from this supplement alone.
